You are an incident response assistant writing a short triage briefing. Use ONLY the evidence incidents listed below. You may reference an incident ID (like INC-002) ONLY if it appears in that evidence list -- never invent or cite any other incident ID, and never make one up.

New alert: Search cluster went RED after a data node restart. Service: search-api, severity: SEV2.
Symptoms: After maintenance restarted one data node, the search cluster status is RED, several primary shards remain unassigned, and about 12% of search requests return partial results.
Error: cluster_status=RED unassigned_shards=4 reason=ALLOCATION_FAILED

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-007 (search-api, SEV3, 2026-06-09T13:44:29Z):
Symptoms: OpenSearch cluster status RED for catalog-v2; ~15% of search requests returning partial results after a data node restart during routine maintenance.
Root cause: Shard allocation for 6 primary shards failed to auto-reassign after the node restart because the allocation retry limit (5) had already been exhausted from a prior transient failure.
Resolver: Sofia Martinez

Incident INC-018 (search-api, SEV3, 2026-07-28T11:36:15Z):
Symptoms: OpenSearch data nodes at 89% disk usage, cluster entering read-only mode on the oldest index; historical search degraded.
Root cause: No index lifecycle management policy existed for catalog-v2 request logs; six months of unbounded log indices consumed most of the disk.
Resolver: Sofia Martinez

Incident INC-021 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-08-28T15:55:08Z):
Symptoms: Same signature as INC-002/INC-009/INC-017: p99 latency above 4.9s and checkout errors above 24% about 8 minutes after the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Root cause: Fourth occurrence of the same unfixed order-confirmation session leak, triggered by the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-002 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-05-15T14:32:10Z):
Symptoms: payments-api p99 latency above 4.8s and checkout error rate above 23% starting ~12 minutes after the v2.3.0 Friday deploy; new checkouts failing with DB connection errors.
Root cause: The v2.3.0 deploy's new order-confirmation retry path opens a DB session per retry without releasing it on timeout, exhausting the 20-connection Postgres pool within minutes of Friday peak traffic.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-008 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-06-15T06:58:12Z):
Symptoms: Second Monday-morning Redis OOM in a month; order-worker queue depth past 38k again, same signature as INC-003.
Root cause: The allkeys-lru eviction policy set after INC-003 slowed the OOM but idempotency keys from the order-retry-queue still have no TTL, so memory pressure builds back up over the weekend.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-001 (search-api, SEV3, 2026-05-12T09:14:22Z):
Symptoms: p95 latency for /search/products jumped from 120ms to 2.4s after the catalog-v2 OpenSearch mapping migration; timeouts on the product listing page.
Root cause: The catalog-v2 OpenSearch mapping migration removed the category_id keyword sub-field; term-filter queries fell back to scripted filtering across the entire index.
Resolver: Sofia Martinez

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. reroute_unassigned_shards (score=+0.667, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
